answer: Ledge-lantern delivery-commitment bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credit, filing a commitment on the public ledge, promising one verified item via a distinct inlet. A lantern inspection checks the item against the commitment: a rented delivery or an inlet under another key burns the bond. First 40, kth 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest identity pays 40 once, keeping its bond.
